topics.title: Our story
example_questions: How did Houston Party Network start?
topics.answer_template:
It started in 2011 with one canceled DJ. A friend's DJ canceled days before their wedding; Craig, then working at a print shop in Tomball, borrowed his cousin's old equipment and did it himself. His cousin told him to keep the gear.

Craig started DJing at Molly's Pub in Tomball, where we still are today. Jason became his first collaborator and TJ his first steady DJ, and the "Network" was intentional from the start: a network of DJs working together instead of competing.

topics.title: Keeping requests friendly
